subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` suppress explicit Gateway control-plane `update.run` managed-service handoffs on supervised/headless installs, or only configured background auto-update applies?
rationale: The source split is clear, but expanding the env var from background auto-update to operator-triggered control-plane updates changes the product contract for incident recovery and update controls.

options.title: Extend the kill-switch to Gateway update.run
options.body: Gate supervised managed-service `update.run` handoffs before helper start/restart scheduling, document the broader scope, and cover launchd/global and background-auto tests.

options.title: Keep the current narrower scope
options.body: Document that `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` affects configured background auto-updates only, and direct operators to disable or avoid explicit control-plane `update.run` separately.

options.title: Add a separate explicit update.run policy
options.body: Introduce a distinct, maintainer-approved setting or env var for blocking control-plane package update restarts without overloading the existing background-auto kill-switch.

recommendation.title: Extend the kill-switch to Gateway update.run
recommendation.body: Gate supervised managed-service `update.run` handoffs before helper start/restart scheduling, document the broader scope, and cover launchd/global and background-auto tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current kill-switch behavior and recently worked in the updater safety surface.
